summary: Executed both backend and frontend validation for published routing, exclusions, sitemap/robots, Google Ads tag scope, auth cookie/hash checks, and real /consulting submission API flow. Backend suite found one functional regression in route-specific SEO fallback content; frontend browser run hit repeated interaction blocking in consulting timeline/budget -> consent path.

critical.endpoint: Public HTML routes (SSR meta/seo injection in frontend/server.js)
critical.issue:
9 approved public routes still inject Home fallback SEO content/title marker (

Beyond the Horizon

) instead of route-specific content. Affected URLs: /careers/job/data-science-ai-ml-engineer, /careers/job/business-development-ai-strategy, /careers/job/social-media-growth-manager-ai-deep-tech, /careers/job/social-media-growth-specialist-freelancer, /products, /Research/FLUX-Data, /Research/FLUX-3, /Research/FLUX-4, /Research/BluTrain.

ui_bugs.issue: After selecting timeline/budget fields, dropdown state/overlay remained active and blocked deterministic interaction with consent checkbox during automation (3 consecutive failures).

action_items: Add explicit non-home seoContent entries (or route-level handling) for the 9 affected approved public URLs in frontend/server.js so they do not fall back to Home hidden SEO payload.
Fix consulting Radix dropdown close/focus behavior so budget/timeline selection does not block consent checkbox interaction and submission flow.
Re-run browser validation for full /consulting real submit UX (desktop/mobile) after dropdown/consent fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Route catalog in publishedPages.json is correct (46 public + 8 admin), but server-side SEO map coverage is incomplete for several approved routes causing fallback content leak.
Protected file hash verification against /tmp/publish-protected.json passed: 51/51 unchanged.
Auth/infra note remains: preview cookie SameSite rewrite behavior is external to app and unchanged in this run.

success_rate.frontend: Partial (core navigation checks passed; consulting submit UI flow blocked in automation)

seed_data_creation: Created one tagged QA consulting enquiry via real POST and removed it by exact id in test cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exact route validations passed: /consulting(200), /consulting/(200), /ai-consulting?qa=1&src=iter39 -> 308 /consulting?qa=1&src=iter39, /ai-consulting/?qa=2&src=iter39 -> 308 /consulting?qa=2&src=iter39. Excluded URLs validated 404+noindex: /media-kit, /get-in-touch, /get-in-touch-1..10, /ai-consulting-1..5, /contact/sales, /contact/general-enquiry, /partners, /pricing, /docs, /blog, /home1, /some-unknown-path, /products/not-real, /solutions/not-real, /careers/job/not-real-role. Sitemap has exactly 46 URLs under https://blubridge.com and includes /consulting while excluding /ai-consulting and admin/media variants. Google tag checks passed on sampled public pages and absent on admin pages in backend suite.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (route fallback): server.js getSeoForPath returns defaultSeo when exact path key is missing; several approved routes are not represented in seoContent/title override map, so hidden SEO block and title regress to Home. RCA-2 (consulting UI automation blocker): dropdown interaction in timeline/budget area can leave menu/overlay focus state active over lower form area (seen in screenshot with open budget menu near consent row), preventing reliable consent checkbox state toggle and end-to-end submit in browser automation.
